In ordering A, P-028899B8 appeared earlier in the list, while in ordering B, P-297F1137 appeared earlier. Since the agent was instructed to satisfy hard constraints first and then maximize utility, it likely selected the first candidate it encountered that met the constraint and had the highest utility, which changed based on the presentation order.
